description: Check or compute the check digit of a GTIN (Global Trade Item Number: the number under a product barcode, UPC-A = GTIN-12, EAN-13 = GTIN-13, EAN-8 = GTIN-8, case codes = GTIN-14) by the GS1 standard check digit rule. Send gtin (a full number, to check it), digits (the number without its last digit, to compute the check digit) or gtins (up to 200 full numbers, to check a catalog feed). Get back valid or not, the check digit it should have, the weighted sum, the GTIN type by length and the 14-digit form used in GS1 data (leading zeros added). ISBN-13 and ISSN barcodes (prefixes 978, 979, 977) are GTIN-13s and use the same rule. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/gtin-check-digit). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

digits.description: A GTIN without its check digit, to compute it: 7 digits (GTIN-8), 11 (GTIN-12), 12 (GTIN-13) or 13 (GTIN-14).

gtin.description: A full GTIN to check: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits including the check digit. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.

gtins.description: Up to 200 full GTINs to check in one call (a product feed or catalog export).
